productArea.name: Labels
productArea.scope: Create, edit, delete, and assign repository and organization labels, including names, descriptions, colors, counts, and mobile layouts. Other issue and pull request controls are outside this area.

entryPoints.directions: Choose Issues then Labels to manage repository labels, and use issue or pull request sidebars to check assignment.
Choose an organization and open Settings then Labels to manage shared labels. Create a disposable organization if needed.
